jobs.title: Engineering Director - Partner Enablement Applications
jobs.aboutTheJobRaw:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

The Client and Partner Technologies (CPT) organization is chartered with enabling brilliant Netflix experiences on devices and building the foundational client systems and tools that make those experiences possible. Within CPT, the Partner Enablement Apps (PEA) group builds and evolves our suite of web applications that power the lifecycle of our device and payments partnerships.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an Engineering Director to lead and scale the Partner Enablement Apps engineering organization. This group develops business‑to‑business applications that enable our device partners (TVs, streaming sticks, set‑top boxes, and other “10‑foot” devices) and operator partners (ISPs, telcos, TV and mobile carriers) to integrate with Netflix APIs, manage device and service lifecycles, and operate Partner Payment experiences (including bundling Netflix with their offerings). Our tools are used both by external partners and by Netflix teams to integrate, launch, operate, monitor, update, and retire partner experiences at scale.

In this role, you’ll drive the long‑term technical strategy, organizational health, and delivery excellence across multiple teams, ensuring our partner and internal experiences are reliable, intuitive, and ready for the next generation of integrations.

The Team

You will lead a growing engineering organization that is primarily based in Warsaw, Poland and includes team members in the United States, Brazil, Netherlands, and Taiwan. The organization currently consists of four domains and requires building strong relationships across time zones and fostering a cohesive, high-performing culture despite geographic distribution.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Define and drive the long-term technical vision and roadmap for Enablement Applications, aligning with broader Netflix objectives

  • Partner with Product Managers, Designers, and senior leadership across wider organization and cross-functional stakeholders to influence organizational strategy and prioritization

  • Identify opportunities for innovation and platform evolution that will scale to support Netflix's next hundred million customers

  • Own the technical and organizational strategy for migrating and deprecating legacy services while maintaining operational excellence

People Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Build, mentor, and retain a world-class engineering team, including hiring and developing engineering managers and senior individual contributors

  • Create an environment where engineers at all levels can do the best work of their careers

  • Foster a culture of continuous learning, psychological safety, and engineering excellence

  • Champion diversity and inclusion, ensuring all team members can thrive regardless of background

  • Provide thoughtful coaching and career development support tailored to individual growth needs

Technical Excellence & Delivery

  • Establish and maintain a strong, mature foundation for core services across all Enablement Apps:

    • Comprehensive testing strategies (unit, integration, automated testing)

    • Robust monitoring, alerting, and observability

    • Scalable and sustainable on-call support models

    • Data quality and engineering best practices

  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners to design and implement scalable, performant, and reliable solutions

  • Stay current with industry trends, tools, and technologies, assessing their relevance and driving adoption where appropriate

Operational Excellence

  • Own reliability and support for Partner Enablement Applications, including first-tier support for internal and external partners

  • Drive operational maturity through metrics, SLOs, and continuous improvement initiatives

  • Balance innovation with stability, ensuring the team delivers value while maintaining system health

Cross-Functional Partnership

This is a highly collaborative role with partners across multiple time zones. While the cross-functional partners make every effort to accommodate time zone differences, effective collaboration requires meetings outside standard local working hours. The schedule is managed flexibly to balance business needs and personal schedule. 

Travel to other organizational locations is expected several times per year to participate in leadership offsites, planning sessions, and strengthening cross-functional relationships.

  • Build strong relationships with Product, Design, Partner Engineering, and Business Development teams

  • Effectively communicate technical concepts and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders

  • Navigate complex organizational dynamics and drive alignment across distributed teams

​Requirements

Experience

  • Extensive software development experience with strong technical foundations

  • Significant experience managing managers or leading multiple teams with prior team management experience

  • Proven track record of building and scaling engineering organizations

  • Experience with distributed systems, web applications, and cloud infrastructure

Leadership & Communication

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization

  • Strong judgment and ability to make high-quality decisions in ambiguous situations

  • Experience fostering inclusive team cultures where diverse perspectives are valued

  • Comfortable with in-office collaboration a few days per week (team and partners work in person regularly)

Technical

  • Deep understanding of full-stack engineering practices and modern software development methodologies

  • Familiarity with CI/CD systems (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Spinnaker), build tools (Gradle), and cloud platforms

  • Strong grasp of reliability engineering principles (monitoring, alerting, incident management)

  • Demonstrated success working with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones

  • Demonstrated experience or strong interest in building intelligent systems powered by AI, including agent-based architectures and task automation—moving beyond traditional enterprise web applications toward the next generation of software development.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in B2B platform development or partner-facing applications

  • Background in device ecosystem management or consumer electronics partnerships

  • Experience with data platforms and analytics systems

  • Prior experience at a high-growth technology company operating at scale

jobs.title: UI Engineer 5 - Studio Foundation Apps Engineering
jobs.aboutTheJobRaw:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

The Studio Foundation Apps Engineering team is building a next-generation media review and collaboration platform to power the creation of our global slate of feature films and television series. Our mission is to empower directors, producers, and studio executives to collaborate seamlessly and creatively, enabling riveting storytelling through effortless content review, anywhere and at any time.

This is a high-impact, end-to-end engineering role. We are responsible for developing a robust, cross-platform, high-performance system that centralizes and secures the thousands of work-in-progress files — including still images, short video clips, and long-form videos — generated across hundreds of active productions annually.

The Studio Foundation Apps Engineering Team accelerates critical decision-making during Principal Photography and Post-Production by providing a secure, high-fidelity playback experience for pre-release content, incorporating DRM, multi-factor authentication, and visual watermarking to mitigate financial losses from delays. We address complex engineering challenges to deliver a unified experience across all devices and connectivity environments via a sophisticated hybrid cross-platform architecture that ensures system-native performance for features like offline video playback and annotation.

The team owns the full content lifecycle, from media ingestion and robust processing (transcoding and packaging) to implementing sophisticated collaboration features like timecode-based commenting and annotation, ensuring deep integration with the Studio's internal systems to serve as a critical part of the content creation ecosystem, ultimately enhancing how creative teams interact with media throughout the production lifecycle.

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Work cross-functionally to build, test, deploy, and launch UIs that operationalize our workflows at scale.

  • Participate in product reviews and team meetings, providing technical insight. Help scope, estimate, and prioritize between competing needs.

  • Evaluate new technologies and approaches to streamline and improve our rapid application development tooling and conventions.

  • Regularly learn and contribute to new systems and tools as the Netflix platform and ecosystem evolve.

  • Participate in our on-call rotation and lead the incident reviews.

  • Effectively communicate complex technical issues and solutions to stakeholders.

  • Apply engineering best practices to guide projects and decisions, and support the growth of team members.

  • Uphold company values, promoting an inclusive team environment, and ensuring high standards of conduct and performance across teams.

What You'll Find Rewarding About This Role:

  • You are passionate about user experience and enjoy improving UIs, building intuitive user interfaces in close partnership with UX Designers and Product Managers.

  • You enjoy collaborating with Backend and UI engineers, product designers, product managers, and directly with users to understand what they want, determine what they really need, and decide what to build.

  • You are motivated to identify business opportunities that positively impact the organization.

  • You strive to embrace best practices and are always looking for opportunities to continually improve.

  • You are willing to work flexibly across the stack or into a new domain to support a teammate when needed.

  • You drive the resolution of complex problems and lead strategic projects that enhance team capabilities and impact, operating across functional boundaries.

  • You deepen technical mastery to implement sustainable solutions, optimize system efficiency, and make informed decisions on system quality, reliability, and performance.

  • You leverage AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate the software development lifecycle.

  • You actively seek out and evaluate new AI-driven development tools to boost overall team productivity and operational efficiency.

We Would Love to Work With You If You:

  • Are passionate and knowledgeable about UI Engineering and related technologies, and can make, influence, and inform architectural decisions while effectively encouraging diverse perspectives and constructive challenge.

  • Have experience building enterprise applications with React, TypeScript, React-Native, internal UI frameworks, and video player technologies. Familiarity with backend services built primarily with Java Spring Boot, utilizing GraphQL, gRPC, and internal frameworks is valued. Experience with media processing pipelines, transcoding, DRM systems, or cloud-based media services (such as AWS Elemental) is a plus. Familiarity with storage and metadata services (such as S3-based layers) and CI/CD tools (such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar deployment tooling) is beneficial.

  • Demonstrate a strong sense of ownership, independence, willingness to take initiative, and inclination for collaboration. We uphold our values — learn more about our unique culture here.

  • Are able to recognize, communicate, address, and lead technical improvements as part of the roadmap.

  • Have helped define and ensure accountability for UI Engineering best practices across a team.

A Few More Things About Us:

As a team, we come from many different countries, and our fields of education range from the humanities to engineering to computer science. Our team includes product managers, program managers, designers, full-stack developers, distributed systems engineers, and data scientists. Team members have the opportunity to take on different roles, should they choose to. We strongly believe this diversity has helped us build an inclusive and empathetic environment, and we look forward to adding your perspective to the mix!

Does this sound interesting? We'd love to connect with you!

jobs.title: Software Engineer 4 - Graph Search
jobs.aboutTheJobRaw:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

About the Team

The Graph Search team is responsible for building and operating the highly scalable Search-as-a-Service platform that powers search and intelligent discovery across Netflix's internal studio and production applications. Our system streamlines search functions across diverse workflows, allowing hundreds of internal applications and thousands of studio professionals to quickly find, filter, and retrieve highly structured data.

We handle massive data volumes and complex relationships, moving data from transactional source systems into eventually consistent search indices in near-real-time. Most recently, our team has expanded into the intersection of search and AI, taking ownership of intelligent chat-based interfaces that allow users to discover and explore content data using natural language.

The Scope of Work

As an engineer on our team, your tasks will span standard backend engineering as well as deep distributed systems challenges. You will work on optimizing high-throughput data pipelines, managing a massive index topology across large search clusters, and introducing intelligent query-orchestration mechanisms.

Check out the following tech blogs to learn more about the Graph Search platform:

  • How Netflix Content Engineering makes a federated graph searchable

  • How Netflix Content Engineering makes a federated graph searchable (Part 2)

  • Reverse Searching Netflix’s Federated Graph

  • The AI Evolution of Graph Search at Netflix: From Structured Queries to Natural Language

See the video to learn more about the entire Infrastructure & Solution team: Content Infrastructure & Solutions Team

Key Responsibilities

  • Feature Development and Ownership: Implement and own the lifecycle of backend features, search orchestration layers, and data-indexing pipelines end-to-end.

  • Distributed Systems at Scale: Participate in managing, scaling, and optimizing search cluster architecture.

  • Performance Engineering: Collaborate on throughput optimizations, sharding strategies, data consistency, and low-latency metrics for real-time data movement.

  • Technical Collaboration: Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and operational improvements to ensure high developer effectiveness.

  • Testing and Automation: Maintain robust testing practices (unit, integration, and end-to-end) to support high confidence in a continuous deployment culture.

What We Are Looking For

  • Core Software Engineering: Solid foundational knowledge of backend software engineering, typically using Java or similar object-oriented languages.

  • Distributed Infrastructure Aptitude: A strong interest or foundational experience in large-scale data processing, data partitioning, sharding, and real-time messaging workflows.

  • Search and Indexing Exposure: Foundational knowledge or direct experience working with search technologies such as OpenSearch or Elasticsearch, as well as graph databases such as AWS Neptune.

  • Operational Mindset: An understanding of production environments, with a dedication to writing clean, maintainable, and performant code supported by robust testing and monitoring.

  • Effective Communication and Growth: A motivated problem-solver who communicates technical updates clearly, actively seeks feedback, and is comfortable navigating technical ambiguity.

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience building centralized platforms, frameworks, or shared tooling intended for other software engineers to consume.

  • Foundational full-stack or UI experience (TypeScript, React, GraphQL) to contribute to self-service portals and search interfaces.

  • Interest or experience in graph-based data stores (such as AWS Neptune) or hierarchical data models.

  • An interest in learning or applying AI patterns (such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation/RAG, model observability, or agentic workflows) to expand natural language search functionality.

Tech Stack

  • Languages: Java, Python

  • Frameworks: SpringBoot, ReactJS

  • APIs: GraphQL, gRPC, REST

  • Messaging: Apache Kafka

  • Workflow and Data Processing: Netflix Conductor, Apache Flink

  • Databases: OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, AWS Neptune, Cassandra, PostgreSQL

  • Cloud Platform: AWS

You will be responsible for implementing and refining gameplay systems across a diverse portfolio of game prototypes. These prototypes will cover a wide spectrum of genres available in the Netflix portfolio.

The right candidate will possess industry-leading craft expertise, meticulous attention to detail, and a proactive curiosity. This role requires a Senior Gameplay Programmer comfortable working across diverse game genres, from children's titles to AAA Action Adventures games, as well as working with a unique input device (the NGC). You will contribute to every stage of development, from initial vision to creating playable prototypes.

A key expectation is the ability to move seamlessly between gameplay sensibility and hands-on engineering. This includes partnering with designers to shape systems and directly building them yourself using technical fluency in Unreal Engine 5, leveraging a combination of C++ and Blueprints as well as using Gen AI. You must possess the engineering rigor to architect reliable, maintainable systems and the prototyping speed to find the fun fast.

THE TEAM
 

Our mission is to empower small teams of exceptional developers to build breakout hits, leveraging innovative gameplay married with beloved IPs and served with minimal friction within the Netflix ecosystem. We seek new teammates who care deeply about the experiences they create and the people they make them with, who bias towards hands-on action and are energized by the learning that comes with bold experimentation at an agile pace. As a part of Netflix, we strive to hire the best and value integrity, excellence, respect, inclusion, and collaboration.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build Across Genres: Contribute to a rotating slate of projects spanning many different genres, adapting your engineering approach to fit the genre, audience, and platform at hand.

  • Drive Feature Areas End-to-End: Own multiple complex gameplay features from prototype to polished implementation, producing well-engineered, reliable, and maintainable code.

  • Prototype in UE5: Translate design intent into functional, playable systems and mechanics using Unreal Engine 5 with a combination of C++, Blueprints, Gen AI, and custom tools to validate gameplay hypotheses and find the fun fast.

  • Optimize & Debug: Profile, optimize, and debug both code and content across projects as needed to keep prototypes performant on TV via the cloud streaming platform and other targets.

  • Collaboration Catalyst: Partner closely with designers, artists, producers, and other engineers to integrate and improve features, ensuring cohesion between design intent and execution. Participate in code reviews and create documentation and functional tests for the features you build.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

  • Proven experience prototyping and shipping two or more titles as a Gameplay Programmer/Engineer across varied genres, with a focus on excellent player experience.

  • Excellent technical knowledge in C++, optimization, math, and debugging, with extensive hands-on experience in Unreal Engine 5 and strong Blueprint implementation skills.

  • Strong gameplay and design sensibilities, able to partner with designers to shape systems and articulate the core elements that contribute to the "feel" and success of each genre.

  • Demonstrates ability to develop complex features and systems end-to-end, and to produce reliable, maintainable code under fast iterative timelines.

  • Thrives in a fast-moving, prototype-first environment where scope and direction evolve quickly, demonstrating exceptional adaptability to change.

  • Strong communicator who can translate complex technical ideas for other disciplines and communicates actively about the status of their tasks.

  • Maintains a broad and active engagement with games, offering well-informed and strong perspectives on the elements that contribute to an exceptional player experience.

  • Demonstrates good judgement on the required quality level and technical approach for a wide array of tasks ranging from quick and dirty prototypes to shippable features.

  • Demonstrates a commitment to task planning and timely delivery of tasks

REQUIRED APPLICATION DETAILS

  • Resume

  • Portfolio examples are welcomed

LOCATION

This is a remote position based in Canada. However, candidates must be willing to travel for work-related events and adhere to a development team schedule oriented toward Eastern Standard Time (EST).

 

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $140,000.00 - $250,000.00.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Supplemental Health and Dental Plans, Mental Health support, a RRSP Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more detail about our Benefits here.

We aspire to set the industry standard in building a world-class data infrastructure, supporting Netflix’s goal to be the most popular and widely accessible destination for global internet entertainment.

As the Data Platform charter grows, we are expanding our presence to Poland to further increase our impact. We are seeking Distributed Systems Engineers to help evolve and innovate our Product and Infrastructure. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that brings new perspectives as we address the next set of challenges.

Team Spotlights

Data Platform Online Data Stores Team

This team will focus on taking end-to-end ownership of the internal data platform products, including ZooKeeper, one of the critical infrastructure products in our suite, ensuring its continued reliability, scalability and evolution. Over time, this team will expand its charter to more datastores, and to drive broader infrastructure initiatives. This expansion reinforces our mission to boost Netflix engineers’ productivity and innovation by providing a robust, efficient, and secure data platform, while fostering close collaboration between data platform teams to deliver greater organizational throughput and agility.

Experimentation Platform

This team owns the data infrastructure that makes A/B testing work at Netflix. Specifically, they build and maintain the systems that store and govern the record of who was in which experiment, across hundreds of concurrent tests running across streaming, ads, growth, and device platforms. They also own the semantic layer that ties every experiment metric at Netflix back to that allocation data, and the pipelines that keep the whole thing fresh and reliable. As the team matures, the scope grows to include self-service tooling for the teams running experiments and support for AI-driven monitoring and analysis workflows.

Data Movement

The Data Movement Connector EcoSystem at Netflix is a growing domain with an expanding charter to own all the new high-leverage business-critical connectors across Netflix. The team currently offers Frameworks, Libraries, and Control Planes and supports a large set of streaming/incremental and batch/snapshot-based connectors. We believe having the Poland team build and own a set of connectors to move and integrate data across different business domains would be the fastest way to unlock business values. The team will also build the automated systems integration test framework (for batch and streaming connectors). This offers an excellent opportunity to learn the technology stack and deliver direct, relevant impact across the organization.
